name: wise-mcp-server

tools.name: balance-getBalances

profileId.description: The profile ID to get balances for

items.description: The type of balance to get

tools.name: balance-create
tools.description: Create a new balance account for a specific profile

profileId.description: The profile ID to create balance for

tools.name: balance-delete

tools.name: balance-moveOrConvert
tools.description:
Move funds between accounts or convert between currencies using the Wise API.

Approaches:
1. With explicit balance IDs and amount:
   profileId: 12345, sourceBalanceId: 100, targetBalanceId: 200,
   amount: {"value": 100, "currency": "GBP"}

2. With pre-created quote ( for MCP clients if customer already has a quote):
   profileId: 12345, quoteId: "uuid-string"

For cross-currency movements:
* If the user seems interested in seeing fees and rates you can use the quoteId approach.
* If the user doesn't seem interested in seeing fees and rates you can use
  the amount and balanceIds approach.

For same-currency movements, you don't need to provide a quoteId. Just amount and balanceIds.

profileId.description: The profile ID to perform balance movement for

sourceBalanceId.description: Source balance ID. If provided, targetBalanceId must also be provided.

targetBalanceId.description: Target balance ID. If provided, sourceBalanceId must also be provided.

amount.description: Amount to move. {value: number, currency: string}

tools.name: transfer-requirements
tools.description:
Get requirements for creating a transfer between currencies.
  Returns field requirements that must be satisfied when creating a transfer.

  - IMPORTANT! Make sure all the required requirements are met. Give the option
    to the user to fill the required information.
  - IMPORTANT! If a field has 'refreshRequirementsOnChange = true' then submit
    the form again to the tool to get any new requirements.

targetAccount.description: The recipient account ID to send money to

quoteUuid.description: UUID of the quote to use for this transfer

customerTransactionId.description: Unique transaction ID for idempotency. If not provided, one will be generated.

transferPurpose.description: Purpose of the transfer. For example when target currency is THB. See more about conditions via the transfer-requirements tool.

transferPurposeSubTransferPurpose.description: Sub-purposes of the transfer. For example when target currency is CNY. See more about conditions via the transfer-requirements tool.

sourceOfFunds.description: For example when target currency is USD and transfer amount exceeds 80k. See more about conditions via the transfer-requirements tool.

details.description: Additional transfer details. Call the transfer-requirements tool to get the required fields.

tools.name: transfer-create
tools.description:
Create a new transfer using a quote and recipient account.
    - IMPORTANT! Ensure the user selects which balance to send money from.
    - IMPORTANT! Ensure the user selects OR creates the correct targetAccount
      (recipient) to send money to. This is crucial to avoid money going to the
      wrong place!
    - IMPORTANT! Each transfer can have additional 'requirements' that are needed
      in order to process the transfer. To determine the transfer requirements
      needed, call the transfer-requirements tool.
    - IMPORTANT! Ensure the user provides all the required 'requirements' in the
      'details' object.
    - IMPORTANT! The transfer will be created but not funded - use transfer-fund
      to initiate payment.
    - IMPORTANT! Ask the user to provide 'reference' don't automatically create
      one.

targetAccount.description: The recipient account ID to send money to

quoteUuid.description: UUID of the quote to use for this transfer

customerTransactionId.description: Unique transaction ID for idempotency. If not provided, one will be generated.

transferPurpose.description: Purpose of the transfer. For example when target currency is THB. See more about conditions via the transfer-requirements tool.

transferPurposeSubTransferPurpose.description: Sub-purposes of the transfer. For example when target currency is CNY. See more about conditions via the transfer-requirements tool.

sourceOfFunds.description: For example when target currency is USD and transfer amount exceeds 80k. See more about conditions via the transfer-requirements tool.

details.description: Additional transfer details. Call the transfer-requirements tool to get the required fields.

tools.name: transfer-get
tools.description: Get details of a specific transfer by its ID. Returns complete transfer information including status, amounts, and metadata.

transferId.description: The transfer ID to retrieve details for

tools.name: transfer-fund
tools.description:
Fund a transfer to initiate the actual payment.
  This moves money from your account balance to execute the transfer.

profileId.description: The profile ID that owns the transfer

type.description: Payment type - typically "BALANCE" to fund from account balance

mfa.description:
MFA details if required.

     Sending the code will attempt verifying the ott and fund the transfer.

     If code is missing the tool will trigger the MFA process with the selected type.

     - For SMS the tool will attempt sending an SMS with the code.

     - For VOICE the tool will attempt sending a voice call with the code.

     - For PUSH the tool will send a push notification to your saved device.

     - For PASSWORD the code is required to verify the ott and fund the transfer.

tools.name: transfer-list
tools.description: List all transfers for a profile with optional filtering and pagination. Returns transfer history with status and amount information.

profileId.description: The profile ID to list transfers for

offset.description: Number of transfers to skip for pagination

limit.description: Maximum number of transfers to return (1-100)

status.description: Filter transfers by status (e.g., processing, outgoing_payment_sent)

tools.name: transfer-cancel
tools.description: Cancel a transfer that is in a cancellable state. Only transfers that have not been processed can be cancelled.
